spanish: o servicio, en el servicio; o el que enseña, en la enseñanza;

adjudication.decision: **Razones de la traducción** - The initial lowercase «o» reflects that the enumeration continues directly from verse 6. - Both occurrences of «o» translate εἴτε. - «Servicio» translates διακονία without restricting it to an institutional or ecclesiastical office, as «ministerio» might. - The repetition «servicio, en el servicio» reproduces the two explicit occurrences of διακονία. - «El que enseña» translates the article and substantivized participle ὁ διδάσκων. - «En la enseñanza» preserves ἐν τῇ διδασκαλίᾳ. - The Greek contains no explicit verbs equivalent to «que sirva» or «que lo haga» in either expression. - Preserving the ellipsis avoids adding a command or modality absent from the source. - The final semicolon indicates that the enumeration continues in verse 8.
